reference_sql:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND cal_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' AND (is_weekend = true OR event IS NOT NULL)
alternatives:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE (is_weekend = true OR event IS NOT NULL) AND cal_date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31'

SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date >= '2025-12-01' AND cal_date < '2026-01-01' AND (is_weekend OR NOT event IS NULL)

SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE (cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND is_weekend = true) OR (cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND event IS NOT NULL)

other_way.sql:
SELECT cal_date, weekday_name, event
FROM calendar
WHERE (is_weekend = true OR event IS NOT NULL) AND cal_date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31'
other_way.tradeoff: BETWEEN is shorter and keeps both ends, while two comparisons make it easy to turn one end into exclusive.
